# reader-find

The reader's own find bar — case-insensitive matches in the rendered document alone, highlighted without touching the sanitized body, in every reader host.

Read first: `docs/features/reader-find/spec.md`, `docs/features/reader-find/contract.md`

- `kb:adr/process-render-fixtures-record-reader-documents` — A render fixture also records each session's reader listing and documents, and the harness serves the reader's two GETs from it. (accepted, 2026-10-20; features: reader, reader-find, connection) → `docs/adr/process-render-fixtures-record-reader-documents.md`
- `kb:adr/reader-find-highlights-via-css-highlight-api` — The reader's find bar highlights matches with the CSS Custom Highlight API; wrapping them in mark elements was rejected as it mutates the sanitized body. (accepted, 2026-10-17; features: reader-find) → `docs/adr/reader-find-highlights-via-css-highlight-api.md`
- `kb:adr/reader-find-overrides-cmd-f-inside-reader` — Command-F opens the find bar of the reader holding keyboard focus, in every host; with focus outside any reader the browser's own find is left alone. (accepted, 2026-10-17; features: reader-find, shortcuts) → `docs/adr/reader-find-overrides-cmd-f-inside-reader.md`
- `kb:adr/reader-find-query-follows-file-switch` — An open find bar keeps its query across a re-render, without scrolling, and across a file switch, jumping to the first match; closing on switch rejected. (accepted, 2026-10-17; features: reader-find) → `docs/adr/reader-find-query-follows-file-switch.md`
- `kb:lesson/scroll-fix-measured-at-one-offset` — Two scroll fixes in a row were proved at the reviewer's mid-document offset only; each regressed at an end of the range and cost a review cycle. (active, 2026-10-17; features: reader-find) → `docs/lessons/scroll-fix-measured-at-one-offset.md`
